## What it is

nipplejs, a virtual joystick library (minified).

## How it works

- Imported by `frontend.js`; creates the analog stick and D-pad zones of the touch virtual gamepad.

## Why it exists

Touch devices have no gamepad; nipplejs gives responsive on-screen sticks.
